items.title: Thomas Andrew Dorsey Interview, 1980-08-06
items.q: I played the same cabaret. He did.

ctx.x: Did you know any of the jazz players that came up from New Orleans in the early twenties, like Joe Oliver?
Yeah, Joe Oliver. I did, I know him. I played the same cabaret. He did.
Did you tell us anything about him? Anything that comes back to mind? No, I couldn't, but he's a little bit beyond me. Yeah. All I could do, hey Joe, how you doing?
